copy.description_500c:
OkSaaS is a curated directory of new SaaS products, indie tools and startups, published as a weekly drop. Makers submit their product through a short form and get a listing page with a logo, a description, a category and a dofollow backlink to their site, at no cost.

Visitors browse 850+ listed tools across 22 categories, including AI, developer tools, marketing and SEO, design, productivity, finance and no-code, and filter them by recency. The site is static and fast, exposes an agents.md file for AI agents, and offers sponsored and featured placements for makers who want more visibility.
key_features: Free product launch with a dofollow backlink
Weekly drop of new launches, filterable by recency
agents.md and llms.txt for AI agents
